name: Saltmarsh Railway Society
description: A volunteer society restoring and running a small narrow-gauge railway from Saltmarsh Halt to Lantern Quay. Trains run at weekends in summer. We are always looking for people to help on the line.
hours_note: Trains run on Saturdays and Sundays from April to October. Outside the season the site is open for volunteer work parties only.

stops.name: Saltmarsh Halt
stops.note: The booking office, tea hut and engine shed.

stops.name: Reedbed Crossing
stops.note: A request stop where the line crosses the reedbeds on a low causeway.

stops.name: Gull Lane
stops.note: The passing loop, halfway along the line.

stops.name: Lantern Quay
stops.note: End of the line, beside the old quay.

roles.name: Guards and ticket sellers
roles.text: Meet visitors, sell tickets and send trains on their way. Training is given.

roles.name: Track and signal gang
roles.text: Work parties on the track, drainage and signals. Boots and gloves are provided.

roles.name: Tea hut and shop
roles.text: Tea, cake and cards for passengers. A few hours on a weekend is plenty.

roles.name: Carriage restorers
roles.text: Sanding, painting and joinery in the engine shed, on weekdays or weekends.

facts.headline: Three miles of narrow-gauge line across the Norfolk marshes, run by volunteers
